proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_companion_creation_family
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's primary mechanic is an activated magic item that creates and controls a companion creature, but MagicItemMechanics only permits passive or generic activation families and has no honest spawned-creature shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can throw this staff ... causing the staff to become a Giant Constrictor Snake in that space. The snake is under your control and shares your Initiative count, taking its turn immediately after yours.

notes: Stopped before authoring Dhall/JSON because the unit's core mechanic requires a creature-companion family for magic items. Secondary gaps include the 1-hour reuse lockout and explicit revert-to-item lifecycle handling, but the first blocker is structural.
